source.text: לְמוֹאָ֡ב כֹּֽה־אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל ה֤וֹי אֶל־נְבוֹ֙ כִּ֣י שֻׁדָּ֔דָה הֹבִ֥ישָׁה נִלְכְּדָ֖ה קִרְיָתָ֑יִם הֹבִ֥ישָׁה הַמִּשְׂגָּ֖ב וָחָֽתָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: Concerning Moab. Thus says Yahweh of hosts, [the] God of Israel: Woe to Nebo, for it is devastated; is put to shame, is captured Kiriathaim; is put to shame the stronghold, and is shattered.

en.L: Concerning Moab. Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the God of Israel: Woe to Nebo, for it is devastated! \q Kiriathaim is put to shame, it is captured; \q the stronghold is put to shame and shattered.
en.B: Concerning Moab. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says this: Woe to Nebo, for it lies in ruins! \q Kiriathaim is disgraced and captured; \q the stronghold is disgraced and shattered.
en.R: This message is about Moab. This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the God of Israel, says: How terrible it will be for Nebo! It is destroyed. \q Kiriathaim is captured, and its people are put to shame. \q The fortress is put to shame and torn down.

es.L: Acerca de Moab. Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: ¡Ay de Nebo, porque ha sido devastada! \q Avergonzada, tomada está Quiriataim; \q avergonzada está la fortaleza, y destrozada.
es.B: Acerca de Moab. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel, dice esto: ¡Ay de Nebo, porque está en ruinas! \q Quiriataim está humillada y conquistada; \q la fortaleza está humillada y destrozada.
es.R: Este mensaje es acerca de Moab. Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Dios de Israel: ¡Qué terrible será para Nebo! Está destruida. \q Quiriataim ha sido conquistada, y su gente avergonzada. \q La fortaleza está avergonzada y derribada.

fr.L: Sur Moab. Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Malheur, Nebo, car elle est dévastée ! \q Qiryathaïm est couverte de honte, elle est prise ; \q la citadelle est couverte de honte et brisée.
fr.B: Au sujet de Moab. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël, dit ceci : Malheur à Nebo, car elle est en ruine ! \q Qiryathaïm est déshonorée et prise ; \q la citadelle est déshonorée et abattue.
fr.R: Ce message concerne Moab. Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu d’Israël : Quel malheur pour Nebo ! Elle est détruite. \q Qiryathaïm est prise, et ses habitants sont couverts de honte. \q La forteresse est couverte de honte et démolie.

sw.L: Kuhusu Moabu. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi, Mungu wa Israeli: Ole, Nebo, kwa maana umeharibiwa! \q Kiriathaimu imeaibishwa, imetwaliwa; \q ngome imeaibishwa na kuvunjwa.
sw.B: Kuhusu Moabu. Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, asemavyo: Ole wake Nebo, kwa maana umekuwa magofu! \q Kiriathaimu imeaibishwa na kutekwa; \q ngome imeaibishwa na kuvunjwa.
sw.R: Ujumbe huu ni kuhusu Moabu. Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mungu wa Israeli, analosema: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa Nebo! Umeangamizwa. \q Kiriathaimu imetekwa, na watu wake wameaibishwa. \q Ngome imeaibishwa na kubomolewa.

vi.L: Về Mô-áp. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán thế này: Khốn cho Nê-bô, vì nó bị tàn phá! \q Ki-ri-a-ta-im bị hổ thẹn, bị chiếm lấy; \q đồn lũy bị hổ thẹn và bị đập tan.
vi.B: Về Mô-áp. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán như vầy: Khốn cho Nê-bô, vì nó đã thành đống đổ nát! \q Ki-ri-a-ta-im bị nhục nhã và bị chiếm; \q đồn lũy bị nhục nhã và bị đập tan.
vi.R: Sứ điệp này nói về Mô-áp. Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán: Thật khốn khổ cho Nê-bô! Nó đã bị tàn phá. \q Ki-ri-a-ta-im bị chiếm, dân nó bị sỉ nhục. \q Đồn lũy bị sỉ nhục và bị phá đổ.

ko.L: 모압에 관하여. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 하나님께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 느보에게 화가 있다. 그것이 황폐해졌다! \q 기랴다임이 수치를 당하고 점령되었다. \q 요새가 수치를 당하고 부서졌다.
ko.B: 모압에 관한 말씀이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 하나님께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 느보에게 화가 있다. 그 성이 폐허가 되었다! \q 기랴다임이 치욕을 당하고 점령되었다. \q 요새가 치욕을 당하고 무너졌다.
ko.R: 이것은 모압에 관한 말씀이다. 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 하나님께서 하시는 말씀이다. 느보에게 끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다! 그 성은 멸망했다. \q 기랴다임은 점령되고, 그 백성은 수치를 당했다. \q 요새는 수치를 당하고 허물어졌다.

pt.L: A respeito de Moabe. Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Ai de Nebo, porque foi devastada! \q Quiriataim foi envergonhada, foi tomada; \q a fortaleza foi envergonhada e despedaçada.
pt.B: Sobre Moabe. Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel: Ai de Nebo, porque está em ruínas! \q Quiriataim foi desonrada e tomada; \q a fortaleza foi desonrada e despedaçada.
pt.R: Esta mensagem é sobre Moabe. É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Deus de Israel, diz: Que desgraça vai cair sobre Nebo! Ela está destruída. \q Quiriataim foi tomada, e o seu povo, envergonhado. \q A fortaleza foi envergonhada e derrubada.

am.L: ስለ ሞዓብ። የእስራኤል አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት እንዲህ ይላል፦ ለናባው ወዮለት! ፈርሷልና። \q ቂርያታይም አፍራለች፤ ተያዘችም፤ \q ምሽጉ አፍሯል፤ ተሰባብሯልም።
am.B: ስለ ሞዓብ። የእስራኤል አምላክ፣ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ለናባው ወዮለት! ፈራርሷልና። \q ቂርያታይም ተዋርዳለች፤ ተማርካለችም፤ \q ምሽጉ ተዋርዷል፤ ተሰባብሯልም።
am.R: ይህ መልእክት ስለ ሞዓብ ነው። የእስራኤል አምላክ፣ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ለናባው ወዮለት! ጠፍቷል። \q ቂርያታይም ተማርካለች፤ ሕዝቧም አፍሯል። \q ምሽጉ አፍሯል፤ ፈርሷልም።

hi.L: मोआब के विषय में। सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर यों कहते हैं: नबो पर हाय, क्योंकि वह उजाड़ दिया गया है! \q किर्यातैम लज्जित हुआ, वह ले लिया गया है; \q गढ़ लज्जित हुआ और चकनाचूर हो गया है।
hi.B: मोआब के बारे में। सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर यह कहते हैं: नबो पर हाय, क्योंकि वह खंडहर हो गया है! \q किर्यातैम का अपमान हुआ और वह ले लिया गया; \q गढ़ का अपमान हुआ और वह चकनाचूर हो गया।
hi.R: यह संदेश मोआब के बारे में है। सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के परमेश्वर यह कहते हैं: नबो का कितना बुरा हाल होगा! वह नाश हो गया है। \q किर्यातैम पर क़ब्ज़ा हो गया है, और उसके लोग लज्जित हैं। \q गढ़ लज्जित है और ढा दिया गया है।

ru.L: О Моаве. Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, Бог Израиля: Горе Нево, потому что он опустошён! \q Посрамлён, взят Кириафаим; \q посрамлена крепость и сокрушена.
ru.B: О Моаве. Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, Бог Израиля: Горе Нево, ведь он лежит в развалинах! \q Кириафаим опозорен и взят; \q крепость опозорена и сокрушена.
ru.R: Это слово о Моаве. Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств, Бог Израиля: Беда ждёт Нево! Он разрушен. \q Кириафаим взят, и его жители опозорены. \q Крепость опозорена и разрушена.

ja.L: モアブについて。万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。ああ、災いだ、ネボは！それは荒らされた。 \q キルヤタイムは辱められ、攻め取られた。 \q 砦は辱められ、打ち砕かれた。
ja.B: モアブについて。万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。ああ、災いだ、ネボは！それは廃墟となった。 \q キルヤタイムは恥を受け、攻め取られた。 \q 砦は恥を受け、打ち砕かれた。
ja.R: これはモアブについてのお告げだ。天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの神はこう言われる。ああ、ネボはなんとひどい目にあうことか！ネボは滅ぼされた。 \q キルヤタイムは攻め取られ、その人々は辱められる。 \q 砦も辱められ、打ち倒される。

decisions.choice: Moab: the nation east of the Dead Sea; Nebo: one of its towns
decisions.reason: Chapter 48 is the oracle on Moab among the oracles on the nations (46-51). Moab lay east of the Dead Sea, between the Arnon and the Zered, and in this period held the plateau north of the Arnon as well. Nebo here is the town of that name (Numbers 32:3, 38), not the mountain. Much of the chapter takes up Isaiah 15-16, the earlier oracle on Moab, and the notes name those places.

decisions.choice: woe: a cry of grief and doom over Nebo
decisions.reason: The word is the cry of mourning used over the dead (22:18) and in the prophets over those facing judgment (22:13; 23:1; Isaiah 1:4).

decisions.choice: is devastated ... captured ... shattered: the fall pictured as already done
decisions.reason: The verbs are in the completed form, the way prophecy speaks of what is certain to come. Kiriathaim was a town of the plateau (Numbers 32:37; Joshua 13:19); with Nebo it is also named in the inscription of Mesha, king of Moab in the ninth century BC.

decisions.choice: the stronghold: a high, secure place, not a town's name
decisions.reason: The word means a height or refuge and is used of God as a stronghold (Psalm 46:8). With the article it most likely means Moab's fortress, or Kiriathaim's own citadel. Some take it as a place name, Misgab, since it stands among towns; no town of that name is known.

decisions.choice: disgraced (B); put to shame (R)
decisions.reason: The verb means both to be shamed and to be dried up or brought to nothing. Literal and Readable keep "put to shame"; Balanced uses "disgraced" for the same sense.

decisions.choice: This message is about Moab
decisions.reason: Readable turns the heading into a sentence and says "How terrible it will be" for "woe", as Isaiah and Jeremiah do elsewhere.

decisions.choice: ¡Ay de Nebo! (L, B); ¡Qué terrible será para Nebo! (R)
decisions.reason: *Hoy* as set in the terms note. Moab's towns take the forms of the published Pentateuch and Joshua (Nebo, Quiriataim, Hesbón, Dibón, Aroer, el Arnón).

decisions.choice: "Ole, ..." (L); "Ole wake ..." (B); "Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa ..." (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for *hoy* in the Swahili prophets, as Luke 6:24.

decisions.choice: "Malheur, Nebo" (L); "Malheur à Nebo" (B); "Quel malheur pour Nebo !" (R)
decisions.reason: *Hoy* as the French terms note sets it for the oracles.

decisions.choice: Khốn cho (L, B); Thật khốn khổ cho (R)
decisions.reason: *Hoy* as a threat is set as "Khốn cho ... / Thật khốn khổ cho ..." for these books; the towns of Moab are written as Joshua 13 and 1 Chronicles 5 have them.

decisions.choice: "~에게 화가 있다" (L, B); "~에게 끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다" (R) for *hoy*
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for *hoy* when it threatens.

decisions.choice: "요새" for *misgab*
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: a high secure place, not a town's name.

decisions.choice: A respeito de Moabe (L), Sobre Moabe (B), Esta mensagem é sobre Moabe (R); Ai de (L, B), Que desgraça vai cair sobre (R)
decisions.reason: The heading takes the form 46:2 sets for "concerning", and the cry of woe (m2) the wording 22:13 sets for the book. The towns of Moab keep the forms Isaiah 15-16 and Numbers give them in Portuguese (Nebo, Quiriataim, Hesbom, Dibom, Aroer, Jaza, Horonaim, Luíte, Zoar, Eglate-Selisia, Ninrim, Eleale, Sibma, Jazer, Quir-Heres), so that the two oracles read alike.

decisions.choice: "Woe to Nebo" is "ለናባው ወዮለት!", the lead's form for hoy; Nebo "ናባው" and Kiriathaim "ቂርያታይም" as Numbers and Joshua on main; the stronghold (misgab) "ምሽጉ", not a name.
decisions.reason: Moab's towns keep the forms on main and in the Isaiah 15-16 draft; the meaning decision reads misgab as a high fortress.

decisions.choice: नबो पर हाय (L, B); नबो का कितना बुरा हाल होगा! (R)
decisions.reason: The woe-cry hoy as the terms note sets it: हाय at Literal and Balanced, and at Readable the English level's "How terrible it will be" in Hindi.

decisions.choice: मोआब, नबो, किर्यातैम
decisions.reason: The places of Moab keep the forms of Deuteronomy, Joshua 13 and Isaiah 15-16 in Hindi, which this chapter echoes at many points.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Hindi
decisions.reason: The English marks God's pronouns with the deity_pronoun setting in this chapter. Devanagari has no capital letters, so the Hindi has no such spans; respect for God comes from the honorific third person. Recorded once for this file.

decisions.choice: "Горе Нево" (L, B); "Беда ждёт Нево" (R)
decisions.reason: The cry hoy in the Prophets note's wording at Literal and Balanced; Readable uses the form "Беда ждёт ...", as Isaiah 5 and Jeremiah 13:27 do in this translation.

decisions.choice: "Нево", "Кириафаим"
decisions.reason: The forms of Numbers 32:37-38 and Joshua 13:19 in this translation; the other towns of Moab in this chapter follow Numbers, Joshua and Isaiah 15-16 likewise.

decisions.choice: "крепость"
decisions.reason: The stronghold is a high, secure place, not a town's name (m4).

decisions.choice: hoy 'el Nevo "ああ、災いだ、ネボは！" (L, B), "ああ、ネボはなんとひどい目にあうことか！" (R), the prophetic hoy form; Nebo "ネボ", Kiriathaim "キルヤタイム".
decisions.reason: m1, m2; prophetic conventions; the ISA 15 and JOS place-name forms.

decisions.choice: R heading "これはモアブについてのお告げだ" in the plain oracle voice, not です・ます.
decisions.reason: Oracles are plain at every level; the heading belongs to the oracle (as ISA 15:1 R).

source.text: אֵ֣ין עוֹד֮ תְּהִלַּ֣ת מוֹאָב֒ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן חָשְׁב֤וּ עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ רָעָ֔ה לְכ֖וּ וְנַכְרִיתֶ֣נָּה מִגּ֑וֹי גַּם־מַדְמֵ֣ן תִּדֹּ֔מִּי אַחֲרַ֖יִךְ תֵּ֥לֶךְ חָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: No more [is the] praise of Moab; in Heshbon they have planned against her evil: Come, and let us cut her off from [being a] nation. Also, Madmen, you will be silenced; after you will go [the] sword.

en.L: There is no more praise of Moab; \q in Heshbon they have planned evil against her: \q "Come, and let us cut her off from [being] a nation." \q You also, Madmen, will be silenced; \q after you the sword will go.
en.B: Moab's renown is gone. \q In Heshbon they have plotted disaster against her: \q "Come, let us wipe her out as a nation." \q You too, Madmen, will be silenced; \q the sword will pursue you.
en.R: No one praises Moab anymore. \q In Heshbon the enemy makes evil plans against Moab: \q "Come, let us destroy Moab, so that it is no longer a nation." \q The town of Madmen will also be silenced. \q Enemy soldiers will chase its people with swords.

es.L: Ya no hay alabanza de Moab; \q en Hesbón planearon mal contra ella: \q «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, y cortémosla para que no sea nación». \q También tú, Madmén, serás silenciada; \q tras de ti irá la espada.
es.B: La fama de Moab se acabó. \q En Hesbón tramaron su desgracia: \q «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, borrémosla como nación». \q Tú también, Madmén, serás silenciada; \q la espada te perseguirá.
es.R: Ya nadie alaba a Moab. \q En Hesbón el enemigo hace planes malvados contra Moab: \q «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, destruyamos a Moab para que deje de ser una nación». \q La ciudad de Madmén también será silenciada. \q Los soldados enemigos perseguirán a su gente con la espada.

fr.L: Il n’y a plus de louange pour Moab ; \q à Heshbon on a projeté du mal contre elle : \q « Venez, et retranchons-la, qu’elle ne soit plus une nation. » \q Toi aussi, Madmen, tu seras réduite au silence ; \q derrière toi ira l’épée.
fr.B: La gloire de Moab n’est plus. \q À Heshbon, on a comploté sa perte : \q « Venez, supprimons-la du rang des nations. » \q Toi aussi, Madmen, tu seras réduite au silence ; \q l’épée te poursuivra.
fr.R: Plus personne ne fait l’éloge de Moab. \q À Heshbon, l’ennemi fait de mauvais projets contre Moab : \q « Venez, détruisons Moab, pour qu’il ne soit plus une nation. » \q La ville de Madmen aussi sera réduite au silence. \q Les soldats ennemis poursuivront ses habitants avec leurs épées.

sw.L: Hakuna tena sifa ya Moabu; \q huko Heshboni wamepanga mabaya juu yake: \q "Njooni, tumkatilie mbali asiwe taifa." \q Wewe nawe, Madmeni, utanyamazishwa; \q upanga utakufuatia.
sw.B: Sifa ya Moabu imetoweka. \q Huko Heshboni wamepanga maafa juu yake: \q "Njooni, tumfutilie mbali kama taifa." \q Wewe nawe, Madmeni, utanyamazishwa; \q upanga utakufuatia.
sw.R: Hakuna mtu anayeisifu Moabu tena. \q Huko Heshboni adui wanapanga mabaya juu ya Moabu: \q "Njooni, tuiangamize Moabu, isiwe taifa tena." \q Mji wa Madmeni nao utanyamazishwa. \q Askari wa adui watawafukuza watu wake kwa panga.

vi.L: Mô-áp không còn được ca ngợi nữa; \q tại Hết-bôn người ta mưu điều ác nghịch cùng nó: \q "Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy diệt nó, không cho làm một dân tộc nữa." \q Hỡi Mát-mên, ngươi cũng sẽ bị làm cho câm lặng; \q gươm sẽ đuổi theo ngươi.
vi.B: Danh tiếng Mô-áp không còn nữa. \q Tại Hết-bôn người ta bày mưu hại nó: \q "Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy xóa sổ nó khỏi hàng các dân tộc." \q Hỡi Mát-mên, ngươi cũng sẽ bị làm cho câm lặng; \q gươm sẽ đuổi theo ngươi.
vi.R: Không ai còn ca ngợi Mô-áp nữa. \q Tại Hết-bôn quân thù bày mưu ác chống lại Mô-áp: \q "Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy hủy diệt Mô-áp, để nó không còn là một dân tộc nữa." \q Thành Mát-mên cũng sẽ phải im lặng. \q Quân thù sẽ cầm gươm đuổi theo dân thành ấy.

ko.L: 모압을 칭송하는 일이 다시는 없다. \q 헤스본에서 그들이 그를 해치려고 악을 꾀했다. \q "오너라, 그를 끊어 민족이 되지 못하게 하자." \q 맛멘아, 너도 잠잠해질 것이다. \q 칼이 너를 뒤쫓아 갈 것이다.
ko.B: 모압의 명성은 사라졌다. \q 헤스본에서 그들이 모압을 해칠 재앙을 꾀했다. \q "자, 모압을 없애서 다시는 민족이 되지 못하게 하자." \q 맛멘아, 너도 잠잠해질 것이다. \q 칼이 너를 뒤쫓을 것이다.
ko.R: 이제는 아무도 모압을 칭찬하지 않는다. \q 원수가 헤스본에서 모압을 해치려고 악한 꾀를 낸다. \q "자, 모압을 없애 버리자. 다시는 나라가 되지 못하게 하자." \q 맛멘 성도 잠잠해질 것이다. \q 원수의 군인들이 칼을 들고 그 백성을 뒤쫓을 것이다.

pt.L: Não há mais louvor de Moabe; \q em Hesbom planejaram o mal contra ela: \q "Venham, e a eliminemos de [ser] nação." \q Também tu, Madmém, serás silenciada; \q atrás de ti irá a espada.
pt.B: A fama de Moabe acabou. \q Em Hesbom tramaram a desgraça dela: \q "Venham, vamos acabar com ela como nação." \q Também tu, Madmém, serás silenciada; \q a espada vai te perseguir.
pt.R: Ninguém mais elogia Moabe. \q Em Hesbom o inimigo faz planos maus contra Moabe: \q "Venham, vamos destruir Moabe, para que não seja mais uma nação." \q A cidade de Madmém também vai ficar em silêncio. \q Os soldados inimigos vão perseguir o seu povo com espadas.

am.L: ከእንግዲህ የሞዓብ ምስጋና የለም፤ \q በሐሴቦን ክፉ ነገርን አሰቡባት፦ \q «ኑ፤ ሕዝብ እንዳትሆን እናጥፋት።» \q ማድሜን ሆይ፣ አንቺም ደግሞ ጸጥ ትደረጊያለሽ፤ \q ሰይፍም ይከተልሻል።
am.B: የሞዓብ ዝና ጠፍቷል። \q በሐሴቦን በእርሷ ላይ ጥፋትን አሴሩ፦ \q «ኑ፤ ሕዝብ እንዳትሆን እናጥፋት።» \q ማድሜን ሆይ፣ አንቺም ጸጥ ትደረጊያለሽ፤ \q ሰይፍ ያሳድድሻል።
am.R: ከእንግዲህ ሞዓብን የሚያመሰግን የለም። \q በሐሴቦን ጠላት በሞዓብ ላይ ክፉ ነገር ያቅዳል፦ \q «ኑ፤ ከእንግዲህ ሕዝብ እንዳይሆን ሞዓብን እናጥፋ።» \q የማድሜን ከተማም ጸጥ ትደረጋለች። \q የጠላት ወታደሮች ሕዝቧን በሰይፍ ያሳድዳሉ።

hi.L: मोआब की प्रशंसा अब नहीं रही; \q हेशबोन में उन्होंने उसके विरुद्ध बुराई की युक्ति की है: \q "आओ, हम उसे [एक] जाति [होने] से मिटा डालें।" \q हे मदमेन, तुम भी चुप करा दिए जाओगे; \q तलवार तुम्हारे पीछे चलेगी।
hi.B: मोआब की कीर्ति जाती रही। \q हेशबोन में उन्होंने उसके विरुद्ध विपत्ति की योजना बनाई है: \q "आओ, हम उसे जाति के रूप में मिटा डालें।" \q हे मदमेन, तुम भी चुप करा दिए जाओगे; \q तलवार तुम्हारा पीछा करेगी।
hi.R: अब कोई मोआब की प्रशंसा नहीं करता। \q हेशबोन में शत्रु मोआब के विरुद्ध बुरी योजनाएँ बनाता है: \q "आओ, हम मोआब को नाश कर दें, ताकि वह एक जाति न रहे।" \q मदमेन नगर को भी चुप करा दिया जाएगा। \q शत्रु के सैनिक तलवारें लिए उसके लोगों का पीछा करेंगे।

ru.L: Нет больше славы Моава; \q в Есевоне замыслили против него зло: \q «Пойдём и истребим его, [чтобы он не был] народом.» \q И ты, Мадмена, умолкнешь; \q за тобой пойдёт меч.
ru.B: Пропала слава Моава. \q В Есевоне замыслили против него беду: \q «Пойдём, сотрём его с лица земли как народ.» \q И ты, Мадмена, умолкнешь; \q меч будет преследовать тебя.
ru.R: Никто больше не хвалит Моав. \q В Есевоне враги замышляют против Моава зло: \q «Пойдём и уничтожим Моав, чтобы он больше не был народом.» \q Город Мадмена тоже умолкнет. \q Вражеские воины будут гнаться за его жителями с мечами.

ja.L: モアブの誉れはもうない。 \q ヘシュボンで、彼らはそれに対して悪をたくらんだ。 \q 「さあ、それを断って、国でなくしよう。」 \q マドメンよ、おまえもまた黙らされる。 \q 剣がおまえの後を追う。
ja.B: モアブの名声は消えうせた。 \q ヘシュボンで、人々はモアブに災いをたくらんだ。 \q 「さあ、モアブを滅ぼして、国でなくしてしまおう。」 \q マドメンよ、おまえも黙らされる。 \q 剣がおまえを追って行く。
ja.R: もうだれもモアブをほめたたえない。 \q ヘシュボンで、敵はモアブを滅ぼそうと計画している。 \q 「さあ、モアブを滅ぼして、国でなくしてしまおう。」 \q マドメンの町も、黙らされる。 \q 敵の兵士たちが、剣を持ってその人々を追いかける。

decisions.choice: the praise of Moab: its renown, what it was praised for
decisions.reason: The word is used of the fame or glory of a city (49:25; 51:41). Moab's good name is over.

decisions.choice: in Heshbon they have planned: a play on the town's name
decisions.reason: Heshbon (Hebrew Cheshbon) sounds like the verb "plan" (chashevu): the town whose name means "reckoning" becomes the place where Moab's end is reckoned. Heshbon, Sihon's old city (Numbers 21:26), lay on Moab's northern edge; the enemy plots there, or takes it as a base. "They" are not named; the speech that follows shows that they are the invaders.

decisions.choice: Madmen, you will be silenced: a play on the town's name
alternatives: you will be utterly silenced (no town named)
decisions.reason: The name Madmen sounds like the verb "be silent" (damam), so the town is told it will live up to its name. The place is unknown elsewhere. Some suggest it is Dimon, a form of Dibon (Isaiah 15:9). The ancient Greek translation reads the words as a verb, "she will be utterly silenced", with no town named (a claim from general knowledge).

decisions.choice: come, let us cut her off: the words of the plotters
decisions.reason: The command and the "us" are the enemy's own words, quoted inside the oracle. "From being a nation" means that Moab will no longer exist as a people (compare Psalm 83:5).

decisions.choice: the enemy ... Enemy soldiers will chase its people with swords
decisions.reason: Readable names the plotters, which the Hebrew leaves unstated (m4), and explains "the sword will go after you".

decisions.choice: Hesbón ... Madmén
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on the names: in Heshbon (*ḥeshbon*) they "planned" (*ḥashvu*), and Madmen (*madmen*) "will be silenced" (*tiddommi*). Spanish cannot keep the wordplay.

decisions.choice: the town names kept, with no attempt to copy the Hebrew wordplay
decisions.reason: Heshbon sounds like "planned" and Madmen like "be silenced"; Swahili cannot keep the plays on the names, which the meaning decisions explain.

decisions.choice: the plays on Heshbon ("plan") and Madmen ("be silent") are not reproduced
decisions.reason: French cannot keep the sound-plays; the meaning decisions explain them, as in the English.

decisions.choice: "헤스본에서 ... 꾀했다" and "맛멘아 ... 잠잠해질 것이다", without imitating the wordplay
decisions.reason: The meaning decisions explain the plays on the names (Heshbon, "plan"; Madmen, "be silent"); Korean cannot carry them without changing the names.

decisions.choice: Hesbom ... planejaram; Madmém ... silenciada
decisions.reason: The plays on the names (m2, m3) cannot be kept in Portuguese; the names take their usual forms, "Madmém" with the nasal ending Portuguese writes for "-en", and the notes explain the sound.

decisions.choice: Madmen is "ማድሜን", Heshbon "ሐሴቦን"; the plays on the names (Heshbon / they planned, Madmen / be silenced) are not imitated in Amharic.
decisions.reason: The English keeps the puns only in its meaning decisions; an Amharic reader would need a note to hear them.

decisions.choice: हेशबोन; मदमेन
decisions.reason: Heshbon as Deuteronomy 1:4. Madmen, a town of Moab named only here, is मदमेन (Isaiah 10:31's Madmenah in Benjamin is another place, मदमेना). The Hebrew plays on the names: Heshbon and "planned" (hashav), Madmen and "be silenced" (dmm); Hindi cannot keep the puns.

decisions.choice: "в Есевоне замыслили"; "Мадмена, умолкнешь"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on the names here: Heshbon and "they planned", Madmen and "be silent" (m2, m3). Russian cannot keep the sounds, so each level gives the sense; Heshbon is "Есевон", as in Numbers and Isaiah 15:4.

decisions.choice: "против него", "истребим его"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew calls Moab "she" in much of this chapter; Моав is masculine in Russian, so pronouns and verbs follow Russian grammar at every level, as in 46:21.

decisions.choice: The puns beshbon chashvu (Heshbon / planned) and Madmen tiddommi (Madmen / be silenced) are not imitated; the footnotes explain them.
'aleiha / nakhritennah "それ" (L), "モアブ" (B, R), never 彼女 for the nation; Madmen addressed "おまえ" (the taunt rule).
decisions.reason: Cities and nations are never 彼女 (JER conventions).

source.text: ק֥וֹל צְעָקָ֖ה מֵחֹֽרוֹנָ֑יִם שֹׁ֖ד וָשֶׁ֥בֶר גָּדֽוֹל׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] sound of a cry from Horonaim: devastation and great destruction!

en.L: The sound of a cry from Horonaim: \q devastation and great destruction!
en.B: Listen! A cry from Horonaim: \q ruin and great destruction!
en.R: Listen to the cries from Horonaim! \q There is ruin and terrible destruction.

es.L: Voz de clamor desde Horonaim: \q ¡devastación y gran destrucción!
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}! Un grito desde Horonaim: \q ¡ruina y gran destrucción!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} los gritos desde Horonaim! \q Hay ruina y una destrucción terrible.

fr.L: Le bruit d’un cri, de Horonaïm : \q dévastation et grande destruction !
fr.B: Écoutez ! Un cri, de Horonaïm : \q ruine et grande destruction !
fr.R: Écoutez les cris qui viennent de Horonaïm ! \q Il y a des ruines et une terrible destruction.

sw.L: Sauti ya kilio kutoka Horonaimu: \q uharibifu na maangamizi makuu!
sw.B: Sikiliza! Kilio kutoka Horonaimu: \q uharibifu na maangamizi makuu!
sw.R: Sikilizeni vilio kutoka Horonaimu! \q Kuna uharibifu na maangamizi makubwa.

vi.L: Có tiếng kêu la từ Hô-rô-na-im: \q tàn phá và hủy diệt lớn!
vi.B: Hãy nghe! Có tiếng kêu la từ Hô-rô-na-im: \q điêu tàn và hủy diệt lớn!
vi.R: Hãy nghe tiếng kêu la từ Hô-rô-na-im! \q Thành bị tàn phá và hủy diệt khủng khiếp.

ko.L: 호로나임에서 부르짖는 소리가 난다. \q 파멸과 큰 멸망이다!
ko.B: 들어라! 호로나임에서 부르짖는 소리가 들린다. \q 파멸과 큰 멸망이다!
ko.R: 호로나임에서 들려오는 울부짖음을 들어 보아라! \q 파멸과 무서운 멸망이 닥쳤다.

pt.L: A voz de um clamor desde Horonaim: \q devastação e grande destruição!
pt.B: Escutem! Um grito vem de Horonaim: \q ruína e grande destruição!
pt.R: Escutem os gritos que vêm de Horonaim! \q É ruína e destruição terrível.

am.L: ከሖሮናይም የጩኸት ድምፅ፦ \q ጥፋትና ታላቅ ስብራት!
am.B: ስሙ! ከሖሮናይም ጩኸት ይሰማል፦ \q ጥፋትና ታላቅ ስብራት!
am.R: ከሖሮናይም የሚሰማውን ጩኸት ስሙ! \q ጥፋትና አስከፊ ስብራት ሆኗል።

hi.L: होरोनैम से चिल्लाहट का शब्द: \q उजाड़ और बड़ा विनाश!
hi.B: सुनो! होरोनैम से एक चिल्लाहट: \q बर्बादी और बड़ा विनाश!
hi.R: होरोनैम से आती चीख़ें सुनो! \q वहाँ बर्बादी और भयानक विनाश है।

ru.L: Звук вопля из Хоронаима: \q опустошение и великое разрушение!
ru.B: Слушайте! Крик из Хоронаима: \q разорение и великое разрушение!
ru.R: Слушайте, как кричат в Хоронаиме! \q Там разорение и страшное разрушение.

ja.L: ホロナイムから叫び声がする。 \q 荒廃と大いなる破滅だ。
ja.B: 聞け、ホロナイムから叫び声が上がる。 \q 破壊と大いなる滅びだ。
ja.R: ホロナイムからの叫び声を聞け。 \q 破壊と恐ろしい滅びが起こっている。

decisions.choice: the sound of a cry: listen, a cry
decisions.reason: "The sound of" at the head of a line often works as a call to listen (Isaiah 40:3, 6; Jeremiah 3:21).

decisions.choice: Horonaim: a town in the south of Moab
decisions.reason: Horonaim lay on the way down from the plateau toward the south (Isaiah 15:5; verses 5 and 34 below). It is also named in Mesha's inscription; its exact site is unknown.

decisions.choice: devastation and great destruction: a pair Jeremiah uses for total ruin
decisions.reason: The two words are the plunder of war and a crushing break (4:6, 20; 6:1; Isaiah 59:7; 60:18). They may be what the cry says, or describe what has caused it.

decisions.choice: "Хоронаим"
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah 15:5 in this translation (m2).

decisions.choice: Horonaim "ホロナイム" (ISA 15:5).

source.text: נִשְׁבְּרָ֖ה מוֹאָ֑ב הִשְׁמִ֥יעוּ זְּעָקָ֖ה צְעִירֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Is broken Moab; they have made heard a cry, its little ones.

en.L: Moab is broken; \q its little ones have made a cry heard.
en.B: Moab is shattered; \q its little ones cry out for all to hear.
en.R: Moab is broken. \q Its children are crying out loud.

es.L: Moab ha sido quebrantada; \q sus pequeños han hecho oír su clamor.
es.B: Moab está destrozada; \q sus pequeños gritan para que todos los oigan.
es.R: Moab está quebrantada. \q Sus niños lloran a gritos.

fr.L: Moab est brisé ; \q ses petits ont fait entendre un cri.
fr.B: Moab est brisé ; \q ses petits crient à se faire entendre.
fr.R: Moab est brisé. \q Ses enfants poussent de grands cris.

sw.L: Moabu imevunjika; \q watoto wake wadogo wamepaza kilio.
sw.B: Moabu imevunjwavunjwa; \q watoto wake wadogo wanalia kwa sauti.
sw.R: Moabu imevunjika. \q Watoto wake wanalia kwa sauti kubwa.

vi.L: Mô-áp bị đập tan; \q trẻ nhỏ của nó cất tiếng kêu la.
vi.B: Mô-áp bị nghiền nát; \q trẻ nhỏ của nó kêu khóc vang dội.
vi.R: Mô-áp bị đập tan. \q Trẻ con của nó khóc lớn tiếng.

ko.L: 모압이 부서졌다. \q 그의 어린것들이 부르짖는 소리를 들리게 했다.
ko.B: 모압이 산산이 부서졌다. \q 그의 어린것들이 부르짖는 소리가 멀리까지 들린다.
ko.R: 모압이 부서졌다. \q 그 아이들이 큰 소리로 울부짖는다.

pt.L: Moabe está quebrado; \q os seus pequeninos fizeram ouvir um grito.
pt.B: Moabe está despedaçado; \q os seus pequeninos gritam para todos ouvirem.
pt.R: Moabe está quebrado. \q As suas crianças estão gritando alto.

am.L: ሞዓብ ተሰበረ፤ \q ሕፃናቱ ጩኸትን አሰሙ።
am.B: ሞዓብ ተሰባብሯል፤ \q ሕፃናቱ ሁሉ እንዲሰማ ይጮኻሉ።
am.R: ሞዓብ ተሰብሯል። \q ልጆቹ በታላቅ ድምፅ ያለቅሳሉ።

hi.L: मोआब टूट गया है; \q उसके छोटे बच्चों ने चिल्लाहट सुनाई है।
hi.B: मोआब चकनाचूर हो गया है; \q उसके छोटे बच्चे ऐसे चिल्लाते हैं कि सब सुनते हैं।
hi.R: मोआब टूट गया है। \q उसके बच्चे ज़ोर-ज़ोर से रो रहे हैं।

ru.L: Сокрушён Моав; \q его малые подняли крик.
ru.B: Моав сокрушён; \q его малые дети кричат, и всем слышно.
ru.R: Моав разбит. \q Его дети громко кричат.

ja.L: モアブは打ち砕かれた。 \q その幼い者たちは叫び声を聞かせた。
ja.B: モアブは打ち砕かれた。 \q その幼い者たちが、大声で叫んでいる。
ja.R: モアブは打ち砕かれた。 \q その子どもたちが、声を上げて泣いている。

decisions.choice: its little ones: the reading of the Hebrew text
alternatives: they have made a cry heard as far as Zoar
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is read as "its little ones", the children, or the humble and weak. The ancient Greek translation reads "to Zoar", from nearly the same letters, which would give "they have made the cry heard as far as Zoar" (compare verse 34; Isaiah 15:5). The Greek reading is given here from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: Moab is broken: the fall pictured as already done
decisions.reason: As in verse 1, the completed form speaks of the certain future. The verb "break" returns through the chapter (verses 17, 25, 38, 39).

source.text: כִּ֚י מַעֲלֵ֣ה הַלּוּחִ֔יתבִּבְכִ֖י יַֽעֲלֶה־בֶּ֑כִי כִּ֚י בְּמוֹרַ֣ד חוֹרֹנַ֔יִם צָרֵ֥י צַֽעֲקַת־שֶׁ֖בֶר שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For [the] ascent of the Luhith, with weeping goes up weeping; for on [the] descent of Horonaim [the] distresses of [the] cry of destruction they have heard.

en.L: For [on] the ascent of Luhith \q with weeping, weeping goes up; \q for on the descent of Horonaim \q they have heard the anguish of the cry of ruin.
en.B: Up the climb to Luhith \q they go weeping, weeping all the way; \q on the way down to Horonaim \q they have heard the anguished cry of disaster.
en.R: People climb the hill to Luhith, \q weeping and weeping as they go. \q On the road down to Horonaim \q they hear the painful cries about the disaster.

es.L: Porque [por] la cuesta de Luhit \q con llanto sube el llanto; \q porque en la bajada de Horonaim \q han oído la angustia del grito de destrucción.
es.B: Por la subida de Luhit \q van llorando, llorando sin parar; \q en la bajada hacia Horonaim \q han oído el grito angustioso de la catástrofe.
es.R: La gente sube la cuesta de Luhit \q llorando y llorando mientras camina. \q En el camino que baja a Horonaim \q se oyen los gritos de dolor por la catástrofe.

fr.L: Car [à] la montée de Louhith \q avec des pleurs, les pleurs montent ; \q car à la descente de Horonaïm \q on a entendu l’angoisse du cri de la ruine.
fr.B: Sur la montée de Louhith, \q on monte en pleurant, en pleurant sans cesse ; \q sur la descente de Horonaïm, \q on a entendu des cris d’angoisse devant le désastre.
fr.R: Les gens gravissent la colline de Louhith \q en pleurant et pleurant encore. \q Sur la route qui descend à Horonaïm, \q on entend des cris de douleur à cause du désastre.

sw.L: Kwa maana [katika] mpando wa Luhithi \q kwa kilio, kilio kinapanda; \q kwa maana katika mteremko wa Horonaimu \q wamesikia dhiki ya kilio cha maangamizi.
sw.B: Kwenye mlima wa kupanda kwenda Luhithi \q wanapanda wakilia, wakilia njia yote; \q kwenye njia ya kushuka kwenda Horonaimu \q wamesikia kilio cha uchungu cha maafa.
sw.R: Watu wanapanda mlima kwenda Luhithi, \q wakilia na kulia wanapokwenda. \q Kwenye njia ya kushuka kwenda Horonaimu \q wanasikia vilio vya uchungu kuhusu maafa.

vi.L: Vì trên dốc lên Lu-hít, \q người ta vừa đi lên vừa khóc mãi; \q vì trên dốc xuống Hô-rô-na-im \q người ta nghe tiếng kêu la đau đớn vì sự tàn phá.
vi.B: Trên đường dốc lên Lu-hít, \q người ta vừa đi vừa khóc, khóc suốt dọc đường; \q trên đường xuống Hô-rô-na-im, \q người ta nghe tiếng kêu la thảm thiết vì tai họa.
vi.R: Người ta leo đồi lên Lu-hít, \q vừa đi vừa khóc mãi không thôi. \q Trên đường xuống Hô-rô-na-im, \q người ta nghe tiếng kêu la đau đớn về tai họa.

ko.L: 루힛 비탈길을 \q 울며 또 울며 올라가고, \q 호로나임 내리막길에서 \q 멸망의 울부짖음의 고통을 그들이 들었다.
ko.B: 루힛으로 오르는 비탈길을 \q 그들이 울고 또 울며 올라간다. \q 호로나임으로 내려가는 길에서 \q 멸망을 슬퍼하는 비통한 부르짖음이 들린다.
ko.R: 사람들이 루힛으로 가는 언덕길을 \q 울고 또 울며 올라간다. \q 호로나임으로 내려가는 길에서 \q 재앙 때문에 고통스럽게 울부짖는 소리가 들린다.

pt.L: Pois [na] subida de Luíte \q com choro sobe o choro; \q pois na descida de Horonaim \q ouviram a angústia do grito de ruína.
pt.B: Pela subida de Luíte \q vão subindo, chorando o caminho todo; \q na descida para Horonaim \q ouviram o grito angustiado de desastre.
pt.R: As pessoas sobem o morro de Luíte \q chorando e chorando pelo caminho. \q Na estrada que desce para Horonaim \q elas ouvem os gritos de dor por causa do desastre.

am.L: በሉሒት አቀበት \q ልቅሶ በልቅሶ ይወጣልና፤ \q በሖሮናይም ቁልቁለትም \q የጥፋትን ጩኸት ጭንቀት ሰምተዋልና።
am.B: የሉሒትን አቀበት \q እያለቀሱ፣ እያለቀሱም ይወጣሉ፤ \q ወደ ሖሮናይም በሚወርደው መንገድ ላይ \q የጥፋትን የጭንቀት ጩኸት ሰምተዋል።
am.R: ሰዎች ወደ ሉሒት ኮረብታ ይወጣሉ፤ \q እየሄዱም ያለቅሳሉ፤ ደጋግመውም ያለቅሳሉ። \q ወደ ሖሮናይም በሚወርደው መንገድ ላይ \q ስለ ደረሰው ጥፋት የሚያሰሙትን የሥቃይ ጩኸት ይሰማሉ።

hi.L: क्योंकि लूहीत की चढ़ाई पर \q रोते-रोते रोना चढ़ता है; \q क्योंकि होरोनैम की उतराई पर \q उन्होंने विनाश की चिल्लाहट की पीड़ा सुनी है।
hi.B: लूहीत की चढ़ाई पर \q वे सारे रास्ते रोते-रोते चढ़ते हैं; \q होरोनैम की उतराई पर \q उन्होंने विपत्ति की दुख भरी दुहाई सुनी है।
hi.R: लोग लूहीत की पहाड़ी पर चढ़ते हैं, \q और चलते-चलते रोते ही जाते हैं। \q होरोनैम से नीचे जानेवाले मार्ग पर \q वे इस विपत्ति के कारण दुख भरी चीख़ें सुनते हैं।

ru.L: Ведь на подъём Лухит \q с плачем восходит плач; \q ведь на спуске Хоронаима \q слышат тоску крика гибели.
ru.B: На подъём к Лухиту \q идут с плачем, плача всю дорогу; \q на спуске к Хоронаиму \q слышен горестный крик о беде.
ru.R: Люди поднимаются в гору к Лухиту \q и всё плачут и плачут. \q На дороге вниз к Хоронаиму \q слышны горькие крики о беде.

ja.L: まことに、ルヒトの上り坂を、 \q 泣きながら、泣きながら上って行く。 \q まことに、ホロナイムの下り坂で、 \q 彼らは破滅の叫びの苦しみを聞いた。
ja.B: ルヒトへの上り坂を、 \q 彼らは泣きながら、泣き続けて上って行く。 \q ホロナイムへの下り坂で、 \q 破滅を嘆く苦しい叫びを聞いた。
ja.R: 人々は、ルヒトへの坂を、 \q 泣きに泣きながら上って行く。 \q ホロナイムへの下り道で、 \q その災いのことを嘆く苦しい叫び声を聞く。

decisions.choice: the ascent of Luhith, the descent of Horonaim: Isaiah 15:5 taken up
decisions.reason: The verse repeats Isaiah 15:5 with changes: Isaiah has "they go up it" where this verse has "weeping goes up" (one letter different), "the road to Horonaim" where this has "the descent of Horonaim", and "they raise a cry of ruin" where this has "they have heard the anguish of the cry of ruin". Both places lay on the route of flight to the south; their sites are unknown.

decisions.choice: with weeping, weeping goes up: weeping on weeping
decisions.reason: The doubled word stresses grief without end. The line may also be read "with weeping one goes up, weeping"; the sense is the same: the refugees weep all the way up the slope.

decisions.choice: the anguish of the cry of ruin: a cry full of distress
alternatives: the enemies have heard the cry of ruin
decisions.reason: The first word most likely means "distresses", so that the cry is an anguished one. The same letters can mean "enemies", giving "the enemies have heard the cry of ruin". The ancient Greek translation has no word for it (a claim from general knowledge), and Isaiah 15:5 has a different verb.

decisions.choice: Luhith: the reading of the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: The written letters here differ slightly from the name's spelling; the reading tradition gives Luhith, as in Isaiah 15:5.

decisions.choice: the climb to / the way down to
decisions.reason: Balanced follows the wording of Isaiah 15:5 ("Up the climb to Luhith") and gives the new word "descent" as "the way down".

decisions.choice: a subida de Luíte; Horonaim; grito ... de desastre (B)
decisions.reason: The verse takes up Isaiah 15:5 (m1), and each level keeps the Portuguese of Isaiah 15:5 where the Hebrew is the same ("Pela subida de Luíte vão subindo, chorando o caminho todo" at Balanced, "o morro de Luíte" at Readable); "a descida", new here, is worded afresh.

decisions.choice: the line follows Isaiah 15:5 in the Amharic draft ("የሉሒት አቀበት", "የሖሮናይም መንገድ", "የጥፋት ጩኸት"); Jeremiah has "the descent of Horonaim" ("ቁልቁለት") and "weeping goes up with weeping".
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says Isaiah 15:5 is taken up; the Amharic keeps the Isaiah wording where the Hebrew is the same and follows Jeremiah where it differs.

decisions.choice: wording of Isaiah 15:5 reused
decisions.reason: This verse repeats Isaiah 15:5b-c with small changes ("descent" for "road", "they have heard" for "they raise"). The Hindi keeps Isaiah's wording at each level (लूहीत की चढ़ाई पर ... रोते हुए चढ़ते हैं; होरोनैम ... विनाश की चिल्लाहट / विपत्ति की दुहाई) and changes only what the Hebrew changes.

decisions.choice: the Russian of Isaiah 15:5 for the shared words
decisions.reason: Isaiah 15:5 taken up (m1): each level copies its Isaiah 15:5 wording in this translation ("подъём (к) Лухит(у)", "крик гибели" at Literal, "крик о беде" at Balanced and Readable) and adds "спуск" for the descent, which Isaiah does not have.

decisions.choice: The ISA 15:5 forms where the Hebrew agrees: "ルヒトの上り坂" (L), "ルヒトへの上り坂" (B), "ルヒトへの坂" (R); "ホロナイム"; Jeremiah's "descent" and "they have heard" follow the Hebrew here.
decisions.reason: m1: Isaiah 15:5 taken up; the wording is matched where the Hebrew is the same.

source.text: נֻ֖סוּ מַלְּט֣וּ נַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וְתִֽהְיֶ֕ינָה כַּעֲרוֹעֵ֖ר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Flee, save your lives, and let them be like a juniper in the wilderness.

en.L: Flee! Save your lives, \q and be like a juniper in the wilderness!
en.B: Run! Save your lives! \q Be like a bare shrub in the wilderness!
en.R: Run away and save your lives! \q Live like a lonely bush in the desert.

es.L: ¡{{plural_you:Huyan|Huid}}! ¡{{plural_you:Salven|Salvad}} {{plural_you:sus vidas|vuestras vidas}}, \q y {{plural_you:sean|sed}} como un enebro en el desierto!
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Corran|Corred}}! ¡{{plural_you:Salven|Salvad}} {{plural_you:sus vidas|vuestras vidas}}! \q ¡{{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} como una mata pelada en el desierto!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Huyan|Huid}} y {{plural_you:salven|salvad}} {{plural_you:sus vidas|vuestras vidas}}! \q {{plural_you:Vivan|Vivid}} como un arbusto solitario en el desierto.

fr.L: Fuyez ! Sauvez vos vies, \q et soyez comme un genévrier dans le désert !
fr.B: Fuyez ! Sauvez votre vie ! \q Soyez comme un arbuste dénudé dans le désert !
fr.R: Fuyez et sauvez votre vie ! \q Vivez comme un buisson isolé dans le désert.

sw.L: Kimbieni! Okoeni nafsi zenu, \q mkawe kama mreteni nyikani!
sw.B: Kimbieni! Okoeni maisha yenu! \q Muwe kama kichaka kikavu nyikani!
sw.R: Kimbieni, mkaokoe maisha yenu! \q Ishini kama kichaka kilicho peke yake jangwani.

vi.L: Hãy chạy trốn! Hãy cứu mạng sống mình, \q và hãy như cây bách xù trong hoang mạc!
vi.B: Hãy chạy đi! Hãy cứu mạng sống mình! \q Hãy như bụi cây trơ trụi trong hoang mạc!
vi.R: Hãy chạy trốn và cứu mạng sống mình! \q Hãy sống như bụi cây lẻ loi trong sa mạc.

ko.L: 도망하여라! 너희 목숨을 구하여라. \q 광야의 노간주나무처럼 되어라!
ko.B: 도망하여라! 목숨을 건져라! \q 광야에 홀로 선 덤불처럼 되어라!
ko.R: 도망하여 목숨을 구하여라! \q 사막에 홀로 서 있는 덤불처럼 살아라.

pt.L: Fujam! Salvem a vida de vocês, \q e sejam como um zimbro no deserto!
pt.B: Corram! Salvem a vida! \q Sejam como um arbusto seco no deserto!
pt.R: Fujam e salvem a vida! \q Vivam como um arbusto sozinho no deserto.

am.L: ሽሹ! ነፍሳችሁን አድኑ፤ \q በምድረ በዳም እንዳለ የጥድ ቁጥቋጦ ሁኑ!
am.B: ሩጡ! ነፍሳችሁን አድኑ! \q በምድረ በዳ እንዳለ ብቸኛ ቁጥቋጦ ሁኑ!
am.R: ሽሹ፤ ሕይወታችሁንም አድኑ! \q በምድረ በዳ እንዳለ ብቸኛ ቁጥቋጦ ኑሩ።

hi.L: भागो! अपने प्राण बचाओ, \q और निर्जन प्रदेश में अरार के झाड़ के समान हो जाओ!
hi.B: भागो! अपने प्राण बचाओ! \q निर्जन प्रदेश में एक सूखी झाड़ी के समान हो जाओ!
hi.R: भाग जाओ और अपनी जान बचाओ! \q सुनसान इलाक़े में अकेली झाड़ी की तरह रहो।

ru.L: Бегите! Спасайте ваши жизни, \q и будьте как можжевельник в пустыне!
ru.B: Бегите! Спасайте свою жизнь! \q Будьте как голый куст в пустыне!
ru.R: Бегите и спасайте свою жизнь! \q Живите, как одинокий куст в пустыне.

ja.L: 逃げよ。自分の命を救え。 \q 荒野のねずの木のようになれ。
ja.B: 逃げよ。命を救え。 \q 荒野の裸の木のようになれ。
ja.R: 逃げて、命を救うがいい。 \q 荒野にぽつんと立つ木のように暮らすがいい。

decisions.choice: like a juniper in the wilderness: a lone shrub in dry land
alternatives: like a wild donkey in the wilderness
decisions.reason: The word names a desert shrub, perhaps a juniper, used in 17:6 for someone stripped and alone. The refugees will live like it, bare and cut off in the wilderness. The same letters spell Aroer, the town of verse 19, so some read "be like Aroer in the wilderness". The ancient Greek translation reads "like a wild donkey", from a word that looks similar (a claim from general knowledge).

decisions.choice: be: the verb is feminine plural
decisions.reason: The commands "flee" and "save" are masculine plural, but "be" is feminine plural. It may agree with "lives" (a feminine word): "let your lives be like a shrub". The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: a bare shrub
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the wording of 17:6 for the same shrub; Literal keeps "juniper".

decisions.choice: Live like a lonely bush
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means: the refugees will live alone in the desert like a single bush (m1).

decisions.choice: un enebro (L); una mata pelada (B); un arbusto solitario (R)
decisions.reason: The plant (*ʿaroʿer*) is a juniper or a bare desert shrub; the word also sounds like the town Aroer (verse 19).

decisions.choice: "mreteni" (juniper, L); "kichaka kikavu" (B); "kichaka kilicho peke yake" (R)
decisions.reason: The plant is uncertain, a juniper or a bare desert shrub; Literal names the juniper as the English Literal does, and Balanced and Readable describe a lone shrub in dry land.

decisions.choice: "노간주나무" (L); "덤불" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal names the shrub as the English Literal does ("juniper"); the meaning decision says it is a lone shrub in dry land, and Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: zimbro (L); arbusto seco (B)
decisions.reason: The shrub (m1) keeps the words 17:6 gives it in Portuguese at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: अरार का झाड़ (L); सूखी झाड़ी (B); अकेली झाड़ी (R); निर्जन प्रदेश (L, B), सुनसान इलाक़ा (R)
decisions.reason: The ar'ar is a desert juniper or shrub (the word also sounds like the town Aroer, verse 19); Literal names it, the other levels describe it, as the English. The wilderness takes the style guide's forms.

decisions.choice: "можжевельник" (L); "голый куст" (B)
decisions.reason: The words of 17:6 in this translation for the same lone shrub (m1).

decisions.choice: 'aro'er "ねずの木" (L), "裸の木" (B), "ぽつんと立つ木" (R).
decisions.reason: m1: the word is uncertain (juniper, a bare shrub, or the town Aroer); the footnote gives the other readings.

source.text: כִּ֠י יַ֣עַן בִּטְחֵ֤ךְ בְּמַעֲשַׂ֨יִךְ֙ וּבְא֣וֹצְרוֹתַ֔יִךְ גַּם־אַ֖תְּ תִּלָּכֵ֑דִי וְיָצָ֤א כְמוֹשׁ֙ בַּגּוֹלָ֔ה כֹּהֲנָ֥יו וְשָׂרָ֖יו יַחְדָּֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: For because you trusted in your works and in your treasures, also you will be captured; and will go out Chemosh into exile, his priests and his princes together.

en.L: For because you trusted in your works and in your treasures, \q you too will be captured; \q and Chemosh will go out into exile, \q his priests and his princes together.
en.B: Because you trusted in your achievements and your treasures, \q you too will be taken. \q Chemosh will go off into exile, \q together with his priests and his officials.
en.R: You trusted in the things you had done and in your riches. \q So you too will be captured. \q Your god Chemosh will be carried away to a foreign land, \q along with his priests and leaders.

es.L: Porque por cuanto confiaste en tus obras y en tus tesoros, \q también tú serás tomada; \q y Quemos saldrá al destierro, \q sus sacerdotes y sus príncipes juntamente.
es.B: Por haber confiado en tus logros y en tus tesoros, \q también tú serás capturada. \q Quemos irá al destierro, \q junto con sus sacerdotes y sus jefes.
es.R: Confiaste en lo que habías hecho y en tus riquezas. \q Por eso también tú serás capturada. \q Tu dios Quemos será llevado a una tierra extranjera, \q junto con sus sacerdotes y sus dirigentes.

fr.L: Car parce que tu t’es confié en tes œuvres et en tes trésors, \q toi aussi tu seras pris ; \q et Kemosh s’en ira en exil, \q ses prêtres et ses princes ensemble.
fr.B: Parce que tu t’es confié en tes réussites et en tes trésors, \q toi aussi tu seras capturé. \q Kemosh partira en exil, \q avec ses prêtres et ses chefs.
fr.R: Tu as mis ta confiance dans ce que tu avais fait et dans tes richesses. \q Alors toi aussi, tu seras capturé. \q Ton dieu Kemosh sera emmené dans un pays étranger, \q avec ses prêtres et ses chefs.

sw.L: Kwa maana kwa sababu uliyatumaini matendo yako na hazina zako, \q wewe nawe utatwaliwa; \q na Kemoshi atakwenda uhamishoni, \q makuhani wake na wakuu wake pamoja.
sw.B: Kwa sababu ulitegemea mafanikio yako na hazina zako, \q wewe nawe utatekwa. \q Kemoshi atachukuliwa uhamishoni, \q pamoja na makuhani wake na maafisa wake.
sw.R: Uliyategemea mambo uliyoyafanya na utajiri wako. \q Kwa hiyo wewe nawe utatekwa. \q Mungu wako Kemoshi atachukuliwa mpaka nchi ya kigeni, \q pamoja na makuhani wake na viongozi wake.

vi.L: Vì ngươi đã tin cậy vào công việc và kho báu của mình, \q nên ngươi cũng sẽ bị bắt; \q và Kê-móc sẽ đi lưu đày, \q cùng với các thầy tế lễ và các quan trưởng của nó.
vi.B: Vì ngươi đã tin cậy vào thành tựu và kho báu của mình, \q nên ngươi cũng sẽ bị bắt. \q Kê-móc sẽ bị đày đi, \q cùng với các thầy tế lễ và các quan chức của nó.
vi.R: Ngươi đã tin cậy vào những việc ngươi làm và vào của cải của ngươi. \q Vì thế ngươi cũng sẽ bị bắt. \q Thần Kê-móc của ngươi sẽ bị đem đi xứ lạ, \q cùng với các thầy tế lễ và các nhà lãnh đạo của nó.

ko.L: 네가 네 업적과 네 보물을 의지했기 때문에, \q 너도 사로잡힐 것이다. \q 그모스가 포로가 되어 끌려가고, \q 그의 제사장들과 그의 고관들도 함께 [끌려갈 것이다].
ko.B: 네가 네가 이룬 것과 네 보물을 의지했으니, \q 너도 사로잡힐 것이다. \q 그모스는 포로가 되어 끌려가고, \q 그의 제사장들과 관리들도 함께 끌려갈 것이다.
ko.R: 너는 네가 이룬 일과 네 재물을 믿었다. \q 그러니 너도 사로잡힐 것이다. \q 너희 신 그모스도 남의 나라로 끌려갈 것이다. \q 그의 제사장들과 지도자들도 함께 끌려갈 것이다.

pt.L: Pois, porque confiaste nas tuas obras e nos teus tesouros, \q também tu serás tomada; \q e Quemos sairá para o exílio, \q os seus sacerdotes e os seus príncipes juntamente.
pt.B: Porque confiaste nas tuas realizações e nos teus tesouros, \q também tu serás tomada. \q Quemos irá para o exílio, \q junto com os seus sacerdotes e os seus oficiais.
pt.R: Tu confiaste nas coisas que fizeste e nas tuas riquezas. \q Por isso também tu serás capturada. \q O teu deus Quemos vai ser levado para uma terra estrangeira, \q junto com os seus sacerdotes e líderes.

am.L: በሥራሽና በሀብትሽ ታምነሻልና፤ \q አንቺም ደግሞ ትያዢያለሽ፤ \q ካሞሽም ወደ ምርኮ ይወጣል፤ \q ካህናቱና አለቆቹም በአንድነት።
am.B: በሠራሽው ሥራና በሀብትሽ ስለ ታመንሽ \q አንቺም ደግሞ ትማረኪያለሽ። \q ካሞሽ ከካህናቱና ከሹማምንቱ ጋር \q በአንድነት ተማርኮ ይሄዳል።
am.R: ባደረግሽው ነገርና በሀብትሽ ታመንሽ። \q ስለዚህ አንቺም ደግሞ ትማረኪያለሽ። \q አምላክሽ ካሞሽ ወደ ባዕድ አገር ተማርኮ ይወሰዳል፤ \q ካህናቱና መሪዎቹም ከእርሱ ጋር ይወሰዳሉ።

hi.L: क्योंकि तुमने अपने कामों और अपने ख़ज़ानों पर भरोसा रखा, \q इसलिए तुम भी पकड़े जाओगे; \q और कमोश बंधुआई में जाएगा, \q उसके याजक और उसके हाकिम एक साथ।
hi.B: तुमने अपनी उपलब्धियों और अपने ख़ज़ानों पर भरोसा रखा, \q इसलिए तुम भी पकड़े जाओगे। \q कमोश बंधुआई में चला जाएगा, \q अपने याजकों और अपने अधिकारियों के साथ।
hi.R: तुमने अपने कामों और अपने धन पर भरोसा रखा। \q इसलिए तुम भी पकड़े जाओगे। \q तुम्हारा देवता कमोश परदेश ले जाया जाएगा, \q और उसके साथ उसके याजक और अगुवे भी।

ru.L: Ведь за то, что ты надеялся на свои дела и на свои сокровища, \q и ты будешь взят; \q и Хамос пойдёт в изгнание, \q его священники и его князья вместе.
ru.B: Ты надеялся на свои дела и свои сокровища — \q потому и ты будешь взят. \q Хамос уйдёт в изгнание, \q а с ним его священники и вельможи.
ru.R: Ты надеялся на то, что сделал, и на свои богатства. \q Поэтому и тебя захватят. \q Твоего бога Хамоса уведут в чужую страну \q вместе с его священниками и начальниками.

ja.L: まことに、おまえは自分の業と自分の財宝に頼ったので、 \q おまえもまた捕らえられる。 \q ケモシュは捕囚となって出て行く、 \q その祭司たちと長たちも共に。
ja.B: おまえは自分の成し遂げたことと財宝に頼ったので、 \q おまえもまた捕らえられる。 \q ケモシュは捕囚となって出て行く。 \q その祭司たちも高官たちも共に。
ja.R: おまえは、自分のしてきたことと自分の富に頼った。 \q だから、おまえも捕らえられる。 \q おまえの神ケモシュは、外国へ連れて行かれる。 \q その祭司たちも指導者たちも一緒に。

decisions.choice: your works and your treasures: what Moab had made and stored up
decisions.reason: "Works" can mean deeds or the things a people has made, such as fortresses and cities; with "treasures" it means Moab's achievements and wealth. The ancient Greek translation reads "your strongholds" (a claim from general knowledge). Trusting in such things instead of God is a theme of Jeremiah (9:22; 17:5).

decisions.choice: Chemosh: the god of Moab
decisions.reason: Chemosh was the national god of the Moabites (Numbers 21:29; Judges 11:24). Solomon built him a high place near Jerusalem (1 Kings 11:7), which Josiah tore down (2 Kings 23:13). The written text spells the name slightly differently here; the reading tradition gives the usual form.

decisions.choice: Chemosh will go into exile: the god cannot save even himself
decisions.reason: Conquerors carried off the statues of defeated nations' gods with their priests and leaders (Isaiah 46:1-2; Jeremiah 43:12). The god Moab trusted is taken captive with the people. The line is close to Amos 1:15, said of Ammon's king, and Jeremiah 49:3 says it again of Milcom.

decisions.choice: princes (L); officials (B); leaders (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this word (sar) in a court setting.

decisions.choice: Your god ... carried away to a foreign land
decisions.reason: Readable says who Chemosh is and what exile means (m2, m3).

decisions.choice: Quemos
decisions.reason: The god of Moab, as published 1 Kings 11:7 and 2 Kings 23:13.

decisions.choice: "Kemosh"
decisions.reason: The published French form of the god of Moab (1 Kings 11:7).

decisions.choice: Kê-móc
decisions.reason: The god of Moab is written as 1 Kings 11:7 and 2 Kings 23:13 have him; Readable adds "thần", as the English adds "your god".

decisions.choice: "그모스"
decisions.reason: The form published in 1 Kings 11:7 and the Kings tables.

decisions.choice: Quemos; tu (Moab as a woman)
decisions.reason: The god (m2) is "Quemos", as Numbers 21:29 and 1 Kings 11:7 have him in Portuguese. Moab is spoken to as a woman here ("tu", feminine), as the Hebrew's feminine forms show; where the Hebrew speaks of Moab as "he", Portuguese says "ele".

decisions.choice: Chemosh is "ካሞሽ", as 1 Kings 11 and Numbers 21:29 on main; its princes "አለቆቹ" (Literal), "ሹማምንቱ" (Balanced), "መሪዎቹ" (Readable).
decisions.reason: One form of the god's name through the chapter (verses 7, 13, 46).

decisions.choice: कमोश; हाकिम (L), अधिकारी (B), अगुवे (R)
decisions.reason: Chemosh, Moab's god, as 1 Kings 11:7, 33; the princes as elsewhere in this block.

decisions.choice: "Хамос"; "князья" (L), "вельможи" (B), "начальники" (R)
decisions.reason: Chemosh in the form of 1 Kings 11 and Numbers 21:29 in this translation (m2); the officials in the words set for the sarim, as in 49:3.

decisions.choice: Moab addressed (feminine sg) "おまえ" at every level, the taunt rule for hostile nations (46-51).
decisions.reason: JER conventions: おまえ only for taunts of hostile nations and kings.

decisions.choice: Chemosh "ケモシュ" (1KI 11:7); sarav "長たち" (L), "高官たち" (B), "指導者たち" (R).
decisions.reason: m2; the JER sarim forms.

source.text: וְיָבֹ֨א שֹׁדֵ֜ד אֶל־כָּל־עִ֗יר וְעִיר֙ לֹ֣א תִמָּלֵ֔ט וְאָבַ֥ד הָעֵ֖מֶק וְנִשְׁמַ֣ד הַמִּישֹׁ֑ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And will come a destroyer to every city, and a city not will escape; and will perish the valley, and will be destroyed the plateau, as has said Yahweh.

en.L: And a destroyer will come against every town, and no town will escape; \q the valley will perish, and the plateau will be destroyed, \q as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has said.
en.B: The destroyer will come upon every town; not one town will escape. \q The valley will be ruined and the plateau laid waste, \q just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has said.
en.R: The enemy who destroys will attack every town. Not one town will escape. \q The valley will be ruined, and the high plain will be destroyed. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has said this will happen.

es.L: Y vendrá el destructor a toda ciudad, y ninguna ciudad escapará; \q y perecerá el valle, y será destruida la llanura, \q como ha dicho {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: El destructor vendrá contra todas las ciudades; ni una ciudad escapará. \q El valle quedará arruinado y la meseta devastada, \q tal como lo ha dicho {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: El enemigo que destruye atacará todas las ciudades. Ni una sola escapará. \q El valle quedará arruinado, y la llanura alta será destruida. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha dicho que así sucederá.

fr.L: Et le dévastateur viendra contre toute ville, et aucune ville n’échappera ; \q la vallée périra, et le plateau sera détruit, \q comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a dit.
fr.B: Le dévastateur viendra sur chaque ville ; pas une ville n’échappera. \q La vallée sera ruinée et le plateau ravagé, \q comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a dit.
fr.R: L’ennemi destructeur attaquera chaque ville. Pas une seule ville n’échappera. \q La vallée sera ruinée et le haut plateau sera détruit. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit que cela arriverait.

sw.L: Naye mharibu atakuja juu ya kila mji, wala hakuna mji utakaookoka; \q bonde litaangamia, na uwanda utaharibiwa, \q kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema.
sw.B: Mharibu atakuja juu ya kila mji; hakuna mji hata mmoja utakaookoka. \q Bonde litaharibiwa na uwanda wa juu utafanywa ukiwa, \q kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema.
sw.R: Adui mwangamizi atashambulia kila mji. Hakuna mji hata mmoja utakaookoka. \q Bonde litaharibiwa, na nchi tambarare ya juu itaangamizwa. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amesema kwamba haya yatatokea.

vi.L: Kẻ tàn phá sẽ đến đánh mọi thành, không thành nào thoát khỏi; \q thung lũng sẽ bị hủy hoại, cao nguyên sẽ bị tàn phá, \q như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.
vi.B: Kẻ hủy diệt sẽ đến từng thành; không một thành nào thoát khỏi. \q Thung lũng sẽ điêu tàn, cao nguyên sẽ bị tàn phá, \q đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.
vi.R: Quân hủy diệt sẽ tấn công mọi thành. Không một thành nào thoát khỏi. \q Thung lũng sẽ bị tàn phá, cao nguyên sẽ bị hủy diệt. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán điều ấy sẽ xảy ra.

ko.L: 그리고 멸망시키는 자가 모든 성읍에 올 것이니, 한 성읍도 피하지 못할 것이다. \q 골짜기가 망하고, 평지가 황폐해질 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로이다.
ko.B: 파괴자가 모든 성읍에 들이닥칠 것이니, 한 성읍도 벗어나지 못할 것이다. \q 골짜기는 망하고 고원은 황폐해질 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 그대로이다.
ko.R: 파괴하는 원수가 모든 성읍을 공격할 것이다. 한 성읍도 피하지 못할 것이다. \q 골짜기는 망하고, 높은 평원은 황폐해질 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그렇게 되리라고 말씀하셨다.

pt.L: E um destruidor virá contra toda cidade, e nenhuma cidade escapará; \q o vale perecerá, e o planalto será destruído, \q como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse.
pt.B: O destruidor virá sobre todas as cidades; nenhuma cidade escapará. \q O vale ficará arruinado, e o planalto, devastado, \q como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse.
pt.R: O inimigo que destrói vai atacar todas as cidades. Nenhuma cidade vai escapar. \q O vale vai ficar arruinado, e o planalto vai ser destruído. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse que isso vai acontecer.

am.L: አጥፊም ወደ ከተማ ሁሉ ይመጣል፤ አንዲትም ከተማ አታመልጥም፤ \q ሸለቆው ይጠፋል፤ ደጋውም ይፈርሳል፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ተናገረ።
am.B: አጥፊው በከተማ ሁሉ ላይ ይመጣል፤ አንዲት ከተማ እንኳ አታመልጥም። \q ሸለቆው ይጠፋል፤ ደጋውም ባድማ ይሆናል፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ተናገረው።
am.R: አጥፊው ጠላት ከተማን ሁሉ ይወጋል። አንዲት ከተማ እንኳ አታመልጥም። \q ሸለቆው ይጠፋል፤ ደጋው ሜዳም ይፈርሳል። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይህ እንደሚሆን ተናግሯል።

hi.L: और हर नगर पर नाश करनेवाला आएगा, और कोई नगर न बचेगा; \q और तराई नाश होगी, और समतल भूमि उजाड़ी जाएगी, \q जैसा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा है।
hi.B: नाश करनेवाला हर नगर पर चढ़ आएगा; एक भी नगर न बचेगा। \q तराई नाश हो जाएगी और समतल भूमि उजाड़ दी जाएगी, \q ठीक जैसा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा है।
hi.R: नाश करनेवाला शत्रु हर नगर पर हमला करेगा। एक भी नगर नहीं बचेगा। \q घाटी उजड़ जाएगी, और ऊँचा मैदान नाश हो जाएगा। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा है कि ऐसा ही होगा।

ru.L: И придёт губитель на всякий город, и ни один город не спасётся; \q и погибнет долина, и разорено будет плоскогорье, \q как сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Губитель придёт на каждый город; ни один город не уцелеет. \q Долина погибнет, плоскогорье будет опустошено, \q как сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Враг-губитель нападёт на каждый город. Ни один город не спасётся. \q Долина будет разорена, и высокая равнина будет уничтожена. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал, что так будет.

ja.L: 滅ぼす者がすべての町に来て、一つの町も逃れられない。 \q 谷は滅び、台地は荒らされる。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が言われたとおりに。
ja.B: 滅ぼす者がすべての町に来る。逃れられる町は一つもない。 \q 谷は滅び、台地は荒れ果てる。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が言われたとおりである。
ja.R: 滅ぼす敵が、すべての町を攻める。逃れられる町は一つもない。 \q 谷は荒らされ、高原は滅ぼされる。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が、そうなると言われたのだ。

decisions.choice: the valley and the plateau: the two parts of Moab's land
decisions.reason: "The plateau" is the high tableland north of the Arnon, with towns such as Heshbon, Dibon and Medeba (verse 21; Deuteronomy 3:10; Joshua 13:9). "The valley" is most likely the Jordan valley below it, on the east side of the river (Joshua 13:27).

decisions.choice: a destroyer: the invading army
decisions.reason: The word is the same as in 6:26 and returns in verses 18 and 32. The destroyer is not named; in the setting of chapters 46-51 it is Babylon.

decisions.choice: The enemy who destroys
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the destroyer is an enemy army (m2).

decisions.choice: "плоскогорье" (L, B); "высокая равнина" (R)
decisions.reason: The plateau of Moab, as Joshua 13:9-17 in this translation calls it (m1).

decisions.choice: 'emeq "谷", mishor "台地" (L, B), "高原" (R) (JOS 13:9, DEU 3).
decisions.reason: m1: the two parts of Moab's land.

source.text: תְּנוּ־צִ֣יץ לְמוֹאָ֔ב כִּ֥י נָצֹ֖א תֵּצֵ֑א וְעָרֶ֨יהָ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ינָה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בָּהֵֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: Give wings to Moab, for flying away she will go out; and her cities a desolation will become, without inhabitant in them.

en.L: Give wings to Moab, \q for she will surely fly away; \q and her towns will become a desolation, \q with no one living in them.
en.B: Give Moab wings, \q for she must fly away; \q her towns will become a wasteland, \q with no one left living there.
en.R: Give Moab wings, \q because it must fly away. \q Its towns will become ruins, \q and no one will live in them.

es.L: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} alas a Moab, \q porque volando saldrá; \q y sus ciudades se convertirán en desolación, \q sin quien habite en ellas.
es.B: {{plural_you:Denle|Dadle}} alas a Moab, \q porque tiene que huir volando; \q sus ciudades quedarán desoladas, \q sin nadie que viva en ellas.
es.R: {{plural_you:Denle|Dadle}} alas a Moab, \q porque tiene que escapar volando. \q Sus ciudades quedarán en ruinas, \q y nadie vivirá en ellas.

fr.L: Donnez des ailes à Moab, \q car elle s’envolera sûrement ; \q et ses villes deviendront une désolation, \q sans personne qui y habite.
fr.B: Donnez des ailes à Moab, \q car elle doit s’envoler ; \q ses villes deviendront un désert, \q sans plus personne pour y habiter.
fr.R: Donnez des ailes à Moab, \q parce qu’il doit s’envoler. \q Ses villes deviendront des ruines, \q et personne n’y habitera.

sw.L: Mpeni Moabu mabawa, \q kwa maana hakika ataruka aende zake; \q nayo miji yake itakuwa ukiwa, \q bila mtu wa kukaa ndani yake.
sw.B: Mpeni Moabu mabawa, \q kwa maana ni lazima aruke aende zake; \q miji yake itakuwa nyika, \q bila mtu anayebaki kuishi humo.
sw.R: Ipeni Moabu mabawa, \q kwa sababu ni lazima iruke iende zake. \q Miji yake itakuwa magofu, \q wala hakuna mtu atakayeishi ndani yake.

vi.L: Hãy cho Mô-áp đôi cánh, \q vì nó chắc chắn sẽ bay đi; \q các thành của nó sẽ thành hoang vu, \q không ai ở trong đó.
vi.B: Hãy cho Mô-áp đôi cánh, \q vì nó phải bay đi; \q các thành của nó sẽ thành chốn hoang vu, \q không còn ai ở.
vi.R: Hãy cho Mô-áp đôi cánh, \q vì nó phải bay đi. \q Các thành của nó sẽ thành đống đổ nát, \q và không ai sống ở đó.

ko.L: 모압에게 날개를 주어라. \q 그가 반드시 날아서 나갈 것이다. \q 그의 성읍들이 황무지가 되어 \q 그 안에 사는 사람이 없을 것이다.
ko.B: 모압에게 날개를 달아 주어라. \q 그가 날아서 도망쳐야 한다. \q 그의 성읍들은 황무지가 되고, \q 거기에 사는 사람이 아무도 없을 것이다.
ko.R: 모압에게 날개를 달아 주어라. \q 모압은 날아서 도망쳐야 한다. \q 모압의 성읍들은 폐허가 될 것이다. \q 거기에 사는 사람이 아무도 없을 것이다.

pt.L: Deem asas a Moabe, \q pois ela certamente voará; \q e as suas cidades se tornarão uma desolação, \q sem ninguém que habite nelas.
pt.B: Deem asas a Moabe, \q pois ela precisa fugir voando; \q as suas cidades se tornarão um deserto, \q sem ninguém morando ali.
pt.R: Deem asas a Moabe, \q porque ela precisa fugir voando. \q As suas cidades vão virar ruínas, \q e ninguém vai morar nelas.

am.L: ለሞዓብ ክንፍ ስጡ፤ \q በእርግጥ በርራ ትወጣለችና፤ \q ከተሞቿም ባድማ ይሆናሉ፤ \q የሚኖርባቸውም አይኖርም።
am.B: ለሞዓብ ክንፍ ስጧት፤ \q በርራ መሄድ አለባትና፤ \q ከተሞቿ ባድማ ይሆናሉ፤ \q የሚኖርባቸውም ማንም አይቀርም።
am.R: ለሞዓብ ክንፍ ስጡት፤ \q በርሮ መሄድ አለበትና። \q ከተሞቹ ፍርስራሽ ይሆናሉ፤ \q ማንም አይኖርባቸውም።

hi.L: मोआब को पंख दो, \q क्योंकि वह निश्चय उड़ जाएगी; \q और उसके नगर उजाड़ हो जाएँगे, \q उनमें कोई रहनेवाला न होगा।
hi.B: मोआब को पंख दो, \q क्योंकि उसे उड़ जाना होगा; \q उसके नगर उजाड़ भूमि बन जाएँगे, \q वहाँ कोई रहनेवाला न बचेगा।
hi.R: मोआब को पंख दो, \q क्योंकि उसे उड़कर भागना ही होगा। \q उसके नगर खंडहर बन जाएँगे, \q और उनमें कोई नहीं रहेगा।

ru.L: Дайте крылья Моаву, \q потому что он непременно улетит; \q и его города станут пустошью, \q и никто не будет жить в них.
ru.B: Дайте Моаву крылья, \q ведь он должен улететь; \q его города станут пустыней, \q где никто не останется жить.
ru.R: Дайте Моаву крылья, \q потому что он должен улететь. \q Его города станут развалинами, \q и никто не будет в них жить.

ja.L: モアブに翼を与えよ。 \q それは必ず飛び去るからだ。 \q その町々は荒れ果てた所となり、 \q そこに住む者はいなくなる。
ja.B: モアブに翼を与えよ。 \q それは飛び去るしかないからだ。 \q その町々は荒れ地となり、 \q だれも住む者はいなくなる。
ja.R: モアブに翼を与えるがいい。 \q モアブは飛んで逃げるしかない。 \q その町々は廃墟となり、 \q そこに住む者はいなくなる。

decisions.choice: wings: the sense of the word is uncertain
alternatives: set up a gravestone for Moab
decisions.reason: The word usually means a flower or a shining plate (Isaiah 40:7; Exodus 28:36). Here, beside the verb "fly", it is most likely "wings" or "a wing": Moab must escape as a bird does. Other suggested senses are "salt", which an enemy spread on a ruined town so that nothing would grow (Judges 9:45), and "a gravestone" or marker. The ancient Greek translation reads "signs" (a claim from general knowledge).

decisions.choice: she will surely fly away: a doubled verb for emphasis
decisions.reason: A rare verb, "fly" (natsa), is joined to the common verb "go out" (yatsa), which sound alike; together they mean a sudden, certain flight. The rare verb also sounds like the noun of the first line.

decisions.choice: a desolation: an empty, frightening ruin
decisions.reason: The word is one of Jeremiah's for a land left waste, a horror to those who see it (2:15; 4:7; 25:11).

decisions.choice: it ... Its towns
decisions.reason: Moab is "she" in the Hebrew, as lands often are. Literal and Balanced keep "she"; Readable says "it".

decisions.choice: "날개"
decisions.reason: The English reads "wings"; the meaning decision says the word is uncertain, and Korean follows the English reading.

decisions.choice: पंख
decisions.reason: The rare word tsits is read as "wings", as the English does at every level (it can also mean a flower or salt); the Hindi follows that reading.

decisions.choice: "крылья"
decisions.reason: The sense of the word is uncertain (m1); "крылья" follows the reading the English takes.

decisions.choice: tsits "翼" at every level.
decisions.reason: m1: the sense is uncertain; the footnote gives the other readings.

source.text: אָר֗וּר עֹשֶׂ֛ה מְלֶ֥אכֶת יְהוָ֖ה רְמִיָּ֑ה וְאָר֕וּר מֹנֵ֥עַ חַרְבּ֖וֹ מִדָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Cursed [is one who] does [the] work of Yahweh [with] slackness, and cursed [is one who] holds back his sword from blood.

en.L: Cursed [is] the one who does the work of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with slackness, \q and cursed [is] the one who holds back his sword from blood.
en.B: Cursed is anyone who does the work of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} carelessly, \q and cursed is anyone who keeps his sword from shedding blood.
en.R: A curse on anyone who is lazy in doing {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s work! \q A curse on anyone who holds back his sword and does not use it!

es.L: Maldito el que hace la obra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} con flojedad, \q y maldito el que detiene su espada de la sangre.
es.B: Maldito sea quien hace la obra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} con descuido, \q y maldito sea quien impide que su espada derrame sangre.
es.R: ¡Maldito el que es perezoso para hacer la obra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}! \q ¡Maldito el que retiene su espada y no la usa!

fr.L: Maudit [soit] celui qui fait l’œuvre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} avec négligence, \q et maudit [soit] celui qui retient son épée loin du sang.
fr.B: Maudit soit quiconque fait l’œuvre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} avec négligence, \q et maudit soit quiconque empêche son épée de verser le sang.
fr.R: Malédiction sur celui qui fait mollement le travail {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! \q Malédiction sur celui qui retient son épée et ne s’en sert pas !

sw.L: Amelaaniwa yeye aifanyaye kazi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa ulegevu, \q na amelaaniwa yeye auzuiaye upanga wake usimwage damu.
sw.B: Amelaaniwa kila mtu aifanyaye kazi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa uzembe, \q na amelaaniwa kila mtu auzuiaye upanga wake usimwage damu.
sw.R: Laana juu ya mtu yeyote aliye mvivu katika kuifanya kazi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Laana juu ya mtu yeyote anayeuzuia upanga wake asiutumie!

vi.L: Đáng rủa thay kẻ làm công việc của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cách biếng nhác, \q và đáng rủa thay kẻ giữ gươm mình không cho vấy máu.
vi.B: Đáng nguyền rủa cho kẻ làm công việc của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cách cẩu thả, \q và đáng nguyền rủa cho kẻ giữ gươm mình không cho đổ máu.
vi.R: Đáng nguyền rủa cho kẻ lười biếng khi làm công việc của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Đáng nguyền rủa cho kẻ giữ gươm lại mà không dùng đến!

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 일을 게을리하는 자는 저주를 받을 것이다. \q 자기 칼을 피에서 거두는 자도 저주를 받을 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 일을 소홀히 하는 자는 저주를 받을 것이다. \q 칼을 거두어 피를 흘리지 않는 자도 저주를 받을 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 일을 게으르게 하는 사람은 저주를 받아라! \q 칼을 거두고 쓰지 않는 사람도 저주를 받아라!

pt.L: Maldito [é] aquele que faz a obra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} com negligência, \q e maldito [é] aquele que retém a sua espada do sangue.
pt.B: Maldito é quem faz a obra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} com descuido, \q e maldito é quem impede a sua espada de derramar sangue.
pt.R: Maldito seja quem tem preguiça de fazer o trabalho {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}! \q Maldito seja quem segura a sua espada e não a usa!

am.L: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ሥራ በቸልታ የሚሠራ ርጉም [ነው]፤ \q ሰይፉንም ከደም የሚከለክል ርጉም [ነው]።
am.B: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ሥራ በግዴለሽነት የሚሠራ ሁሉ ርጉም ነው፤ \q ሰይፉን ደም ከማፍሰስ የሚከለክል ሁሉ ርጉም ነው።
am.R: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ሥራ በስንፍና የሚሠራ ሁሉ የተረገመ ይሁን! \q ሰይፉን ይዞ የማይጠቀምበት ሁሉ የተረገመ ይሁን!

hi.L: शापित [है] वह जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का काम ढिलाई से करता है, \q और शापित [है] वह जो अपनी तलवार को लहू से रोके रखता है।
hi.B: शापित है वह जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का काम लापरवाही से करता है, \q और शापित है वह जो अपनी तलवार को लहू बहाने से रोकता है।
hi.R: शाप उस पर जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का काम करने में आलस करता है! \q शाप उस पर जो अपनी तलवार रोके रखता है और उसे नहीं चलाता!

ru.L: Проклят делающий дело {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} небрежно, \q и проклят удерживающий свой меч от крови.
ru.B: Проклят всякий, кто делает дело {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} небрежно, \q и проклят всякий, кто не даёт своему мечу проливать кровь.
ru.R: Проклятие тому, кто лениво делает дело {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}! \q Проклятие тому, кто держит свой меч и не пускает его в ход!

ja.L: 呪われよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の業をなおざりに行う者は。 \q 呪われよ、自分の剣を血から引き止める者は。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の業をいい加減に行う者は呪われる。 \q 自分の剣を血から遠ざける者は呪われる。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の仕事を怠ける者は、のろわれる。 \q 剣を手に取りながら、それを使わない者は、のろわれる。

decisions.choice: the work of the LORD: the judgment on Moab, carried out by its attackers
decisions.reason: The invaders are doing God's work when they strike Moab, as Babylon is God's servant in 25:9 and 27:6. A curse on one who holds back recalls Saul, who spared what God had given to destruction (1 Samuel 15:9, 23), and Ahab, who let Ben-hadad go (1 Kings 20:42). The saying does not praise violence in itself; it says the judgment will be carried out in full.

decisions.choice: with slackness: half-heartedly or deceitfully
decisions.reason: The word means both slack, lazy work (Proverbs 10:4; 12:24) and deceit (Psalm 52:4). Here it is work done carelessly, without full effort.

decisions.choice: cursed ... cursed: a double curse formula
decisions.reason: "Cursed is the one who" is the form of the covenant curses (Deuteronomy 27:15-26; Jeremiah 11:3; 17:5). The verse is prose-like in length, but the accents divide it into two parallel halves and it is set in lines with the rest of the poem.

decisions.choice: A curse on anyone ... does not use it
decisions.reason: Readable puts the curse as an exclamation and says "does not use it" for "holds back from blood".

decisions.choice: Maldito [é] aquele que (L); Maldito é quem (B)
decisions.reason: The covenant curse formula (m3) keeps the shape 11:3 and 17:5 give it in Portuguese.

decisions.choice: 'arur "呪われよ" (L), "呪われる" (B), "のろわれる" (R) (JER.17.5).
decisions.reason: m3; the JER curse forms.

source.text: שַׁאֲנַ֨ן מוֹאָ֜ב מִנְּעוּרָ֗יו וְשֹׁקֵ֥ט הוּא֙ אֶל־שְׁמָרָ֔יו וְלֹֽא־הוּרַ֤ק מִכְּלִי֙ אֶל־כֶּ֔לִי וּבַגּוֹלָ֖ה לֹ֣א הָלָ֑ךְ עַל־כֵּ֗ן עָמַ֤ד טַעְמוֹ֙ בּ֔וֹ וְרֵיח֖וֹ לֹ֥א נָמָֽר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: At ease has been Moab from his youth, and undisturbed he [has been] on his dregs, and not has he been emptied from vessel to vessel, and into exile not has he gone; therefore has remained his taste in him, and his scent not has changed.

en.L: Moab has been at ease from his youth and has settled on his dregs; \q he has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, \q and into exile he has not gone; \q therefore his taste has remained in him, \q and his scent has not changed.
en.B: Moab has lived at ease since his youth, resting undisturbed on his dregs, \q never poured out from jar to jar, \q never carried off into exile. \q So his flavor has stayed in him, \q and his aroma is unchanged.
en.R: Moab has lived in peace since the nation began. It is like wine left to sit on its dregs. \q It has never been poured from one jar to another. \q It has never been taken away into exile. \q So it still tastes the same, \q and its smell has not changed.

es.L: Tranquilo ha estado Moab desde su juventud, \q y ha reposado sobre sus heces; \q no ha sido vaciado de vasija en vasija, \q ni ha ido al destierro; \q por eso su sabor ha quedado en él, \q y su aroma no ha cambiado.
es.B: Moab ha vivido tranquilo desde su juventud, reposando sin que nadie lo moviera sobre sus heces, \q nunca trasvasado de tinaja en tinaja, \q nunca llevado al destierro. \q Por eso su sabor se ha conservado, \q y su aroma no ha cambiado.
es.R: Moab ha vivido en paz desde que nació como nación. Es como vino que se deja reposar sobre sus heces. \q Nunca lo han pasado de una tinaja a otra. \q Nunca lo han llevado al destierro. \q Por eso sigue teniendo el mismo sabor, \q y su olor no ha cambiado.

fr.L: Moab a été tranquille dès sa jeunesse, et il a reposé sur sa lie ; \q il n’a pas été vidé de vase en vase, \q et il n’est pas allé en exil ; \q c’est pourquoi son goût est resté en lui, \q et son parfum n’a pas changé.
fr.B: Moab a vécu tranquille depuis sa jeunesse, reposant sans être dérangé sur sa lie, \q jamais transvasé d’une jarre dans une autre, \q jamais emmené en exil. \q Aussi a-t-il gardé sa saveur, \q et son arôme n’a pas changé.
fr.R: Moab a vécu en paix depuis le début de son histoire. Il est comme du vin qu’on a laissé reposer sur sa lie. \q On ne l’a jamais versé d’une jarre dans une autre. \q Il n’a jamais été emmené en exil. \q Alors il a toujours le même goût, \q et son odeur n’a pas changé.

sw.L: Moabu amekuwa na raha tangu ujana wake, naye ametulia juu ya machujo yake; \q hajamiminwa kutoka chombo hadi chombo, \q wala hajakwenda uhamishoni; \q kwa hiyo ladha yake imebaki ndani yake, \q na harufu yake haijabadilika.
sw.B: Moabu ameishi kwa raha tangu ujana wake, akitulia bila kusumbuliwa juu ya machujo yake, \q hajawahi kumiminwa kutoka mtungi hadi mtungi, \q hajawahi kuchukuliwa uhamishoni. \q Kwa hiyo ladha yake imebaki ndani yake, \q na harufu yake haijabadilika.
sw.R: Moabu imeishi kwa amani tangu taifa lilipoanza. Ni kama divai iliyoachwa ikae juu ya machujo yake. \q Haijawahi kumiminwa kutoka mtungi mmoja hadi mwingine. \q Haijawahi kuchukuliwa uhamishoni. \q Kwa hiyo ladha yake bado ni ile ile, \q na harufu yake haijabadilika.

vi.L: Mô-áp đã được an nhàn từ thuở thơ ấu, \q và yên lặng nằm trên cặn rượu của mình; \q nó chưa từng bị rót từ bình này sang bình khác, \q và chưa từng đi lưu đày; \q vì vậy vị của nó vẫn còn trong nó, \q và mùi của nó không thay đổi.
vi.B: Mô-áp sống an nhàn từ thuở thơ ấu, nằm yên trên cặn rượu của mình, \q chưa bao giờ bị rót từ vò này sang vò khác, \q chưa bao giờ bị bắt đi lưu đày. \q Vì thế hương vị nó vẫn còn nguyên, \q và mùi thơm của nó không thay đổi.
vi.R: Từ khi lập quốc, Mô-áp đã sống yên ổn. Nó giống như rượu để yên trên cặn. \q Nó chưa bao giờ bị rót từ vò này sang vò khác. \q Nó chưa bao giờ bị bắt đi lưu đày. \q Vì thế vị của nó vẫn như xưa, \q và mùi của nó chẳng thay đổi.

ko.L: 모압은 어릴 때부터 평안히 지냈고, 자기 찌끼 위에 가라앉아 있었다. \q 이 그릇에서 저 그릇으로 비워진 적이 없고, \q 포로로 끌려간 적도 없다. \q 그래서 그의 맛이 그 안에 그대로 남아 있고, \q 그의 냄새가 변하지 않았다.
ko.B: 모압은 어릴 때부터 평안히 살았고, 찌끼 위에 가라앉은 채 흔들린 적이 없다. \q 이 항아리에서 저 항아리로 옮겨 부어진 적도 없고, \q 포로로 끌려간 적도 없다. \q 그래서 그의 맛이 그대로 남아 있고, \q 그의 향기가 변하지 않았다.
ko.R: 모압은 나라가 생긴 때부터 평안하게 살았다. 모압은 찌끼 위에 그대로 가만히 둔 포도주와 같다. \q 이 항아리에서 저 항아리로 한 번도 옮겨 부어진 적이 없다. \q 한 번도 포로로 끌려간 적이 없다. \q 그래서 그 맛이 그대로이고, \q 그 냄새도 변하지 않았다.

pt.L: Moabe tem estado tranquilo desde a sua juventude e repousou sobre as suas borras; \q não foi esvaziado de vasilha em vasilha, \q e para o exílio não foi; \q por isso o seu sabor permaneceu nele, \q e o seu aroma não mudou.
pt.B: Moabe viveu tranquilo desde a juventude, descansando sem ser perturbado sobre as suas borras, \q nunca despejado de jarro em jarro, \q nunca levado para o exílio. \q Por isso o seu sabor ficou nele, \q e o seu aroma não mudou.
pt.R: Moabe viveu em paz desde que a nação começou. Ele é como vinho deixado parado sobre a borra. \q Nunca foi passado de um jarro para outro. \q Nunca foi levado para o exílio. \q Por isso continua com o mesmo gosto, \q e o seu cheiro não mudou.

am.L: ሞዓብ ከታናሽነቱ ጀምሮ ተዝናንቶ ኖሯል፤ በአተላውም ላይ ረግቷል፤ \q ከዕቃ ወደ ዕቃ አልተገላበጠም፤ \q ወደ ምርኮም አልሄደም፤ \q ስለዚህ ጣዕሙ በእርሱ ውስጥ ቀርቷል፤ \q ሽታውም አልተለወጠም።
am.B: ሞዓብ ከታናሽነቱ ጀምሮ ተዝናንቶ ኖሯል፤ ሳይነካ በአተላው ላይ አርፏል፤ \q ከማሰሮ ወደ ማሰሮ ፈጽሞ አልተገላበጠም፤ \q ፈጽሞ ተማርኮ አልሄደም። \q ስለዚህ ጣዕሙ በውስጡ ቀርቷል፤ \q መዓዛውም አልተለወጠም።
am.R: ሞዓብ ሕዝብ ከሆነ ጀምሮ በሰላም ኖሯል። በአተላው ላይ እንዲረጋ እንደ ተተወ የወይን ጠጅ ነው። \q ከአንዱ ማሰሮ ወደ ሌላው ፈጽሞ አልተገላበጠም። \q ፈጽሞ ተማርኮ አልተወሰደም። \q ስለዚህ ጣዕሙ እንዳለ ነው፤ \q ሽታውም አልተለወጠም።

hi.L: मोआब अपनी जवानी से निश्चिंत रहा है, और वह अपनी तलछट पर टिका रहा है; \q वह एक बर्तन से दूसरे बर्तन में उँडेला नहीं गया, \q और न वह बंधुआई में गया; \q इसलिए उसका स्वाद उसमें बना रहा है, \q और उसकी गंध नहीं बदली।
hi.B: मोआब अपनी जवानी से चैन से रहा है, अपनी तलछट पर बिना छेड़े पड़ा रहा, \q न कभी एक घड़े से दूसरे घड़े में उँडेला गया, \q न कभी बंधुआई में ले जाया गया। \q इसलिए उसका स्वाद उसमें बना रहा, \q और उसकी सुगंध नहीं बदली।
hi.R: मोआब अपनी शुरुआत से शान्ति से रहा है। वह उस दाखरस की तरह है जो अपनी तलछट पर पड़ा छोड़ दिया गया हो। \q उसे कभी एक घड़े से दूसरे घड़े में नहीं उँडेला गया। \q उसे कभी बंधुआई में नहीं ले जाया गया। \q इसलिए उसका स्वाद वैसा ही है, \q और उसकी गंध नहीं बदली।

ru.L: Беззаботен был Моав от юности своей и покоится на своих дрожжах; \q не переливали его из сосуда в сосуд, \q и в изгнание он не ходил; \q поэтому остался в нём его вкус, \q и запах его не изменился.
ru.B: Моав жил беззаботно с юности, спокойно отстаиваясь на своём осадке; \q его никогда не переливали из кувшина в кувшин, \q никогда не уводили в изгнание. \q Поэтому вкус его остался прежним, \q и аромат его не изменился.
ru.R: Моав жил спокойно с тех пор, как стал народом. Он как вино, которое долго стоит на осадке. \q Его никогда не переливали из одного кувшина в другой. \q Его никогда не уводили в плен. \q Поэтому вкус у него прежний, \q и запах не изменился.

ja.L: モアブは若い時から安らかで、そのおりの上に静かにとどまっていた。 \q 器から器へと移されたことはなく、 \q 捕囚として行ったこともない。 \q それゆえ、その味はそのうちに残り、 \q その香りは変わらなかった。
ja.B: モアブは若い時から気楽に暮らし、おりの上に静かにとどまっていた。 \q かめからかめへと注ぎ移されたことはなく、 \q 捕囚として連れて行かれたこともない。 \q だから、その味はそのまま残り、 \q その香りも変わらない。
ja.R: モアブは国の始まりから、平和に暮らしてきた。それは、おりの上に置いたままのぶどう酒のようだ。 \q 一度も、かめからかめへと移されたことがない。 \q 一度も、捕虜として連れて行かれたことがない。 \q だから、その味は前と同じで、 \q その香りも変わっていない。

decisions.choice: settled on his dregs, not poured from vessel to vessel: wine left undisturbed
decisions.reason: In winemaking the new wine was left on its lees, the sediment, for a time, then poured off into another jar to clear it. Wine left too long on the dregs grows thick and harsh. Moab is pictured as such wine: never disturbed, never purified by trouble, set in its ways. Zephaniah 1:12 uses the same picture for people "thickening on their dregs", sure that God will do nothing.

decisions.choice: his taste and his scent: Moab's character, unchanged
decisions.reason: The flavor and smell of the wine stand for what Moab is like. Because it has never been "poured out" in exile, its pride and complacency remain (verses 29-30). Verse 12 turns the picture into judgment: now it will be poured out.

decisions.choice: into exile he has not gone: Moab's long security
decisions.reason: Moab had been subdued by Israel's kings (2 Samuel 8:2; 2 Kings 3) and paid tribute to Assyria, but it had not been deported as Israel and Judah were.

decisions.choice: It is like wine left to sit on its dregs
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that Moab is pictured as wine, which the Hebrew leaves to the image (m1).

decisions.choice: he, his
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew speaks of Moab as "he", picturing the people as one man; Literal and Balanced keep "he", and Readable says "it".

decisions.choice: sus heces, de vasija en vasija
decisions.reason: Wine left on its dregs grew strong; pouring it from jar to jar cleared it. Moab, never shaken by exile, kept its old character. Moab is masculine in this verse, as in the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "찌끼 위에 가라앉아", "이 그릇에서 저 그릇으로 비워진 적이 없고"
decisions.reason: The picture of wine left on its lees is kept at every level, with Readable naming the wine, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "settled on his dregs" is "በአተላው ላይ ረግቷል"; Readable names the wine, as its English.
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: wine left undisturbed keeps its taste; "አተላ" is the sediment of fermented drink.

decisions.choice: उस दाखरस की तरह
decisions.reason: Readable names the picture of wine left on its dregs, as the English Readable; Literal and Balanced keep the image bare.

decisions.choice: "дрожжи" (L); "осадок" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Wine left undisturbed on its lees (m1); Literal keeps the older word, Balanced and Readable the everyday one.

decisions.choice: shemarav "おり", keli "器" (L), "かめ" (B, R), ta'mo "味", reicho "香り": the wine picture at every level; Moab "モアブ / その", not 彼.
